A sibling control covers a hook that refuses on purpose, whose answer is unchanged. Each fixed door gets an ablation. Changesets: `patch` on each package whose shipped code moves.
- ⛔ Hold-offs:
  - `packages/spec/**`, which includes registering a new ledger code. If no existing `StandardErrorCode` fits, stop and report it with options.
  - `packages/objectql/**`: the class itself, its fields and its message. PR #24674 has an open hunk in `hook-wrappers.ts`.
  - Every other error class's answer.
Container & model: `M` (a judgment on the code choice, two transports), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: the write is refused before and after. Only the refusal's status and code move, onto a member of the published `StandardErrorCode` catalog. No accept set moves, and no code is added. A new ledger code would make this `yes`, and it is out of this dispatch.
Responsibility: this lane's error classification (`packages/types`, `packages/rest`) answers an authored hook's unevaluable condition as an unhandled server fault. The platform path that covers it is fail-closed: the row is not written. It reaches every API caller whose write meets such a condition, and an AI client cannot tell that answer from a crash.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `data-error-classification.ts` or `error-response.ts`, and no `pm:dispatched` claim names them. Read in this act. PR #24666 (#24535) edits `rest-server.ts`, which is another file.
- PR #24674 touches `hook-wrappers.ts`, which is held off here.
- The other dispatches in this act, #24670 and #24633, are disjoint.
